project_overview: CCTNS V1.0 is a system designed to improve crime investigation and criminal detection by providing value to police personnel and citizens through automation and efficient information exchange.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: Administrator with full system access and configuration privileges

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Police personnel responsible for investigating cases

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: General public user who can register complaints

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: Support staff handling defects and enhancement requests

actors.name: Auditor
actors.description: External auditor who can examine audit trails

actors.name: RecordsStaff
actors.description: Records room staff managing case documentation

functions.name: RegisterCase
functions.description: Allows citizens to register complaints with police

functions.name: InvestigateCase
functions.description: Facilitates the investigation process after complaint registration

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Allows users to log and track defects or enhancement requests

functions.name: ExportAuditTrail
functions.description: Exports audit trails for specified cases
acceptance_criteria: Audit data is exported without affecting stored trails
Exported data is complete and accurate

entities.name: Case
entities.description: Police case record containing investigation details

attributes.name: createdAt
attributes.description: Date and time when the case was created

relationships.description: A case can have multiple suspects
A case can have multiple documents

entities.name: Suspect
entities.description: Person suspected of involvement in a case

relationships.description: Suspect is associated with a case

entities.name: Document
entities.description: Document or file associated with a case

relationships.description: Document is associated with a case

entities.name: AuditTrail
entities.description: Record of actions taken on critical entities

relationships.description: Audit trail entry is associated with a case

constraints.description: System must provide detailed context-sensitive help material
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: System must maintain unalterable audit trail
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: System must allow limiting case access to specified users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access case without permission

non_functional_requirements.description: System must provide adequate response times under standard and peak conditions
System must maintain unalterable audit trails
User interfaces must comply with ISO 9241 standards
